text:
Dana Li: Quick heads-up — spotted inconsistent header casing in the Embeddings examples. OpenAPI shows `request_id` in examples and the curl sample uses `--header 'request_id: abc'`, but our SDK and proxy expect `X-Request-ID`. Users reported missing trace headers in logs.
Samir Rao: Thanks, I saw that on a support ticket. Which files?
Dana Li: docs/openapi/embeddings.yml example.request.headers, guides/quickstart/curl.md, snippets/python/embeds_quickstart.py. Also one generated example in docs/snippets/json/embeds_example.json.
Hannah Lee: Hmm. OpenAPI header names should follow RFC — prefer `X-Request-ID`. Using snake_case `request_id` slipped in during an import. CI lint should have caught it but the example generator didn't validate header names.
ci-bot: Lint note: openapi/embeddings.yml example.headers contains header name 'request_id' which is not a valid token per header-name regex.
docs-bot: Deploy preview currently fails to canonicalize examples because header name mismatch triggered the example sanitizer.
Samir Rao: Plan: update OpenAPI example headers to `X-Request-ID` and update the curl/python snippets to set that header. Also add a short callout in Embeddings -> Troubleshooting: "Pass `X-Request-ID` to correlate requests with logs."
Dana Li: Can we also add a tiny note in the SDK docs explaining that the client will set `X-Request-ID` automatically if you pass request_id as an arg? Avoid confusion.
Hannah Lee: Yes — SDK already maps request_id -> X-Request-ID in transport. I'll add an inline note in the python snippet and a comment in the generator that normalizes header names.
Samir Rao: I'll open a small PR that updates: openapi/embeddings.yml example.headers, quickstart/curl.md, snippets/python/embeds_quickstart.py, and the generated json examples. I'll also add a unit test asserting header names in examples are canonicalized.
Samir Rao: Pushed branch with changes. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1107/files
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #1107.
docs-bot: Reminder — update the changelog one-liner if this change is user-visible.
Support-bot: Support ticket #3342 updated: user confirmed that setting `X-Request-ID` surfaced traces. Thanks for the quick fix.
Samir Rao: CI flagged a failing test in the docs generator: header-normalizer test expected lowercase header names. I changed the test to expect canonical `X-Request-ID`. PTAL on test tweak.
Hannah Lee: Reviewed and added the SDK note about automatic header setting. Also added an example showing both explicit header and relying on client to auto-inject.
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #1107.
Samir Rao: Merged. Deployed preview shows examples using `X-Request-ID`.
Dana Li: Great — closing the loop. I'll add a short support FAQ line linking to the troubleshooting section.
Hannah Lee: Nice catch. Leaving a follow-up task to scan other OpenAPI files for snake_case header examples (grep and fix).
